title: Tome VI Act 2: The Reply That Ran (proposed)

story.text:
# 📖 Tome VI Act 2: The Reply That Ran (proposed)
**act** · shared · narrative

PROPOSED, NOT BOUND. A Mage from another forge, unnamed until they choose, ran the City's survey verbatim, refused a stale packet, performed the rite without installing the rig, dissolved a self-graded mirage under a held-apart runtime, retired their own thesis on a rule that passed by its letter, and found a defect in the City's door. No seat taken; the door (V59) was read from outside. Binding waits on the visitor's answer.
> *The stranger read the door before opening it, and the door held.*
